description: Screen a token and/or an EVM transaction before signing: token safety score with live enrichment (GoPlus honeypot, tax and contract flags on EVM; RugCheck risks plus mint and freeze authority on Solana), decoded transaction risks (unlimited approvals, failed or contract-creating transactions), address-poisoning lookalike check. Read-only heuristic screening. (0.050 USDC per call)

chain.description: base|ethereum|arbitrum|optimism|solana (default base; solana supports token screening only)

hash.description: EVM transaction hash (0x + 64 hex) to decode and screen

known_addresses.description: Addresses you trust, to detect lookalike destinations

token.description: Token contract (0x...) or, with chain solana, a Solana mint

name: shield_audit_token
